title: Structural basis of Gabija anti-phage defense and viral immune evasion
authors: Antine SP; Johnson AG; Mooney SE; Leavitt A; Mayer ML; Yirmiya E; Amitai G; Sorek R; Kranzusch PJ
one_liner_zh: 该文通过晶体学和冷冻电镜解析Gabija抗噬菌体防御复合物与病毒免疫逃逸蛋白的结构，虽涉及蛋白质-DNA互作（DNA内切酶降解噬菌体DNA），但核心是宿主防御机制而非TF-DNA转录结合，且方法为结构生物学而非AI或物理模拟，仅部分相关。
abstract: Bacteria encode hundreds of diverse defense systems that protect from viral infection and inhibit phage propagation 1–5 . Gabija is one of the most prevalent anti-phage defense systems, occurring in >15% of all sequenced bacterial and archaeal genomes 1,6,7 , but the molecular basis of how Gabija defends cells from viral infection remains poorly understood. Here we use X-ray crystallography and cryo-EM to define how Gabija proteins assemble into an ∼500 kDa supramolecular complex that degrades phage DNA. Gabija protein A (GajA) is a DNA endonuclease that tetramerizes to form the core of the anti-phage defense complex. Two sets of Gabija protein B (GajB) dimers dock at opposite sides of the complex and create a 4:4 GajAB assembly that is essential for phage resistance in vivo . We show that a phage-encoded protein Gabija anti-defense 1 (Gad1) directly binds the Gabija GajAB complex and inactivates defense. A cryo-EM structure of the virally inhibited state reveals that Gad1 forms an octameric web that encases the GajAB complex and inhibits DNA recognition and cleavage. Our results reveal the structural basis of assembly of the Gabija anti-phage defense complex and define a unique mechanism of viral immune evasion.
abstract_zh: 细菌编码数百种多样的防御系统，以保护自身免受病毒感染并抑制噬菌体增殖1–5。Gabija是最普遍的抗噬菌体防御系统之一，存在于超过15%的已测序细菌和古菌基因组中1,6,7，但Gabija如何防御细胞免受病毒感染的分子基础仍知之甚少。在此，我们使用X射线晶体学和冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）来定义Gabija蛋白如何组装成约500 kDa的超分子复合物，该复合物降解噬菌体DNA。Gabija蛋白A（GajA）是一种DNA内切酶，四聚化形成抗噬菌体防御复合物的核心。两组Gabija蛋白B（GajB）二聚体对接在复合物的相对两侧，形成4:4的GajAB组装体，这对体内噬菌体抗性是必需的。我们表明，一种噬菌体编码的蛋白Gabija抗防御因子1（Gad1）直接结合Gabija GajAB复合物并使防御失活。病毒抑制状态的冷冻电镜结构揭示，Gad1形成八聚体网状结构，包裹GajAB复合物并抑制DNA识别和切割。我们的结果揭示了Gabija抗噬菌体防御复合物组装的 structural basis，并定义了一种独特的病毒免疫逃逸机制。
